column15: Deep-sky object: a bright core and a dust lane.
Comet: low in the west, with a faint tail.
The Sun through a full-aperture solar filter: two sunspot groups.
Planet: two dark belts and the Great Red Spot.
The Moon: almost full, rising in the east.
Lunar feature: terraced walls and central peaks.
Moon of a planet: Io, a tiny disk next to Jupiter.
Asteroid: a star-like point that had moved after an hour.
